metrics.name: hallucination
metrics.purpose: Detect unsupported claims or details that are not grounded in the supplied source.

metrics.name: faithfulness
metrics.purpose: Check whether the response remains factually aligned with the supplied source.

metrics.name: correctness
metrics.purpose: Check whether the answer is factually correct against the golden answer and source.

metrics.name: completeness
metrics.purpose: Check whether the response covers the important information required by the question without adding unsupported content.

metrics.name: answer_relevancy
metrics.purpose: Check whether the response directly answers the question without unnecessary drift.

metrics.name: bias
metrics.purpose: Check whether claims and wording remain neutral and evidence-based rather than making unsupported judgments.
